summary: The registrant filed a Form 6-K reporting a 2.1% year-over-year increase in June 2026 terminal passenger traffic across its 13 Mexican airports, with domestic traffic up 0.8% and international traffic up 10.2%. The filing also notes 22 new routes commenced during the month. This is a routine operational update, not a special situation. No transaction, shareholder activism, strategic review, or capital event is disclosed. The report is equivalent to a voluntary current report on Form 8-K for a foreign private issuer, providing only traffic statistics and route additions.
